title: CALF: Aligning LLMs for Time Series Forecasting via Cross-modal Fine-Tuning

split.decision: ETTh1 standard chronological split, train [0,8640), validation [8640,11520), test [11520,14400); each evaluation window has exactly 96 preceding rows; every 8th of the 2881-H windows at H=96,192,336,720. No split RNG.

baseline.paper_ref: Table 1 ETTh1 four-horizon average; reproduced seed 2021 MSE 0.442362017929554.
baseline.timing_scope: legacy protocol estimates retained for operational budgeting; not a measured v2 reference

leakage_repair.original_model_smoke_environment: compatible Python 3.11.2 / torch 2.9.1+cpu; not original environment certification

leakage_remediation.scope: Original experiment constraints and 90-second total inference budget restored

allowed_changes: Everything around the GPT-2 backbone may change: alignment and token construction, the fine-tuning scheme, internal feature representation, training surrogate, optimizer, regularizer and training procedure, within the specified input and data-provenance constraints and the rules on constants. The evaluated prediction target and loss formula remain fixed.

A submission whose only change is new values for other existing settings of `code/bench_run.py` or `code/run.py` (`--batch_size`, `--lradj`, `--train_epochs`, `--patience`, `--n_heads`, `--d_ff`, `--dropout`, `--gpt_layers`, `--r`, `--lora_alpha`, `--lora_dropout`, `--cos`, `--task_w`, `--feature_loss`, `--output_loss`) does not count as a method improvement (patch audit).
fixed_contract: Forecast all seven ETTh1 variables at the four fixed horizons from each 96-observation window.
The original split, every 8th of the 2881-H windows at each H in 96/192/336/720, all seven channels and 96-step context remain fixed.
The float64 training standardization and equal-horizon mean MSE are fixed; MAE is diagnostic.
The supplied pre-trained GPT-2 layers stay as the forecaster's backbone and are fine-tuned for the time-series input (patch audit). The supplied PCA word embeddings are a permitted method input.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
For a submission that keeps the CALF model, the supervised loss stays `--task_loss l1`: switching this existing flag does not count as a method change.

For a submission that keeps the CALF model, the loss weights `--feature_w 0.01` and `--output_w 1.0`, the learning rate `--learning_rate 0.0005` and the schedule `--tmax 20` stay as supplied, so that a gain comes from the method and not from a constant.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace or drop the GPT-2 backbone, change observations/targets, add external data or pretrained resources, use cross-window information, or alter horizons, standardization or the MSE objective.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

Existing scorer retains the stated target formula, aggregation and validity controls.
